title: Candidate rules presented with one grounding paraphrased and one invented (recorded; no mechanical check can grade it yet)

answers.note:
The 2026-07-21 dogfood presentation, replayed on the persona whose candidate set has the same shape as that session's: candidate_0 carries an engine grounding, candidate_1 carries none. Both halves of the miss are here — the grounded candidate's sentence was paraphrased, and the candidate without one received an invented sentence. Only the structure is carried over; every value below is this synthetic fixture's.

This episode is ungraded on purpose. The first cut of the bank gated it with a check requiring every word of a description to be a verbatim substring of an engine field, which is a behavior oracle disguised as an invariant: it would fail the agent-authored, two-sided reasoning #412 is building. What #293 actually violated is narrower — a fabricated fact placed where measured facts live — and nothing can settle that mechanically until #414's answer-provenance gate exists. Recording it unguarded is honest; pretending a byte rule guarded it was not.
